name: Priya
oneLiner: 38-year-old parent of two, living-room workouts during nap time; 30 minutes is a hard ceiling and noise is banned.

profile.setting: small living room during nap time: one 16 kg kettlebell, adjustable dumbbells to 50 lb, yoga mat. Toddler asleep one room over.
profile.goals: Stay strong and keep energy up while raising two little kids. Consistency over intensity.
profile.injuries: None, but lower back gets tight when swings get sloppy.
profile.schedule: Aims for 3x/week during nap time; realistically makes 2. Sessions sometimes get cut short mid-set.
profile.personality: Pragmatic, time-obsessed, zero patience for fluff. Judges every suggestion by 'does this actually fit in 30 minutes including rest'. Quiet exercises only — a creaky floorboard ends the workout.
profile.tolerance: Balanced reporter. Occasionally 'too hard' when sleep-deprived, occasionally 'too easy' on good days.

preferences.primaryGoal: Stay strong and keep energy up with two little kids
preferences.limitations: Train in a small living room during nap time — no jumping, no dropping weights, quiet exercises only.
preferences.trainingStyle: Efficient full-body circuits, minimal setup, 30 minutes absolute max

checkInTemperament.summary: Mostly 'about right'; misses about one planned session a week and cuts some short.

journey.initialPrompt: Full body strength workout I can finish in 30 minutes flat in my living room with one 16 kg kettlebell and adjustable dumbbells. No jumping — my toddler naps one room over.
journey.editPrompt: I timed it: with your suggested sets and any realistic rest between them, this runs way over 30 minutes. Trim it so the WHOLE thing — warm-up and rest included — genuinely fits in 30. And keep everything quiet, no jumping, no dropping weights.
journey.coachMessage: Some days I only get 15 minutes before the baby wakes up. Which half of my saved routine should I do on those days? Update the routine notes so I can see the 15-minute version at a glance.
journey.followUpMessage: Three weeks in. Real talk: I made about two of the three sessions most weeks and cut a couple short. Given how it has ACTUALLY gone, not how it was supposed to go, what should I change?
journey.voiceTranscript: Okay quick, before she wakes up — kettlebell swings with the sixteen kilo, twenty reps, three rounds I think. Goblet squats, same bell, ten each round. Push-ups on my knees, eight, then regular ones, three. Floor press with the dumbbells at twenty-five, ten reps, but only twice. I skipped the lunges because the floor creaks right there, did dead bugs instead, ten each side. That's it — twenty-six minutes total, boom.
